description: Preview (and, if confirmed, start) a Bitly CSV import onto the signed-in account. Requires Scan Pass or Business. By default this only previews the credit cost and row counts and does not create links; set `confirm` true only after the user accepts the preview. Actual creation may still need a follow-up in the Qorlie app or REST API if the preview says so. Use this when the user has a Bitly export to move. Use create_dynamic_qr or bulk_create_dynamic_qrs to make new Qorlie codes that are not a Bitly import. `csv` is the CSV text. `codeKind` chooses fixed vs editable imports when the plan allows it. `idempotencyKey` prevents duplicate imports on retry.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user accepts the preview cost

idempotencyKey.description: Prevents duplicate creates or updates on retry (max 64 characters)

name: import_bitly_csv
title: Import Bitly links
